headline: qiuqiu jumps from 963rd to 81st on ARC-3

sections.text: qiuqiu gained 4.72 to reach 33.77, moving from 963rd to 81st on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move takes qiuqiu from outside the top 500 into the top 100.
